title: Russian satellite plays 'cat-and-mouse' with a commercial US spacecraft likely used by Ukraine. But why the risky close encounter?
caption:
A Russian military satellite just performed a startlingly close maneuver next to a private American radar craft. Trackers say Kosmos 2612 got within meters of the satellite, which provides critical imagery to Ukraine. This signals that commercial space tech is now a direct military target.

Source: Space - Russian satellite plays 'cat-and-mouse' with a commercial US spacecraft likely used by Ukraine. But why the risky close encounter?
